description: Use this when the user asks what is going viral, trending or performing right now on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Facebook for a topic or niche, what a creator posts that works, or what ads run in the Meta Ad Library. `mode` is keyword (a topic) or profile (an account). Returns posts with views, engagement, links and captions, plus `next_cursor` for more. A fraction of a credit per page (cached pages free). Do not use for general web or news search, or for one profile's outliers versus its own normal (use xcut_find_outliers).

mode.description: keyword to search a topic (e.g. "meal prep"), or profile to see an account's top posts (query = @handle). Default keyword. Facebook supports profile only.
mode.title: Mode

platform.description: instagram, tiktok, youtube, facebook, or meta_ads for the Meta Ad Library.
platform.title: Platform

query.description: A topic, or a handle when mode is profile.
query.title: Query

name: xcut_search_viral
title: Search the viral library
